atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: defines design tokens (colors, fonts, spacing, etc.) as CSS variables that generate corresponding utility classes. https://tailwindcss.com/docs/theme

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: adds a source file or directory for class detection that Tailwind wouldn't otherwise scan. https://tailwindcss.com/docs/detecting-classes-in-source-files

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: registers a custom utility class that participates in variant/important handling like built-in utilities. https://tailwindcss.com/docs/adding-custom-styles#adding-custom-utilities

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: applies a Tailwind variant to a rule inside a custom CSS file. https://tailwindcss.com/docs/adding-custom-styles#applying-a-variant-in-bulk

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: defines a custom variant. https://tailwindcss.com/docs/adding-custom-styles#adding-custom-variants

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: loads a legacy JS-based plugin. https://tailwindcss.com/docs/adding-custom-styles#using-a-javascript-plugin

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: loads a legacy JS config file for compatibility with Tailwind v3 setups. https://tailwindcss.com/docs/upgrade-guide#using-a-javascript-config-file

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: inlines existing utility classes into a custom CSS rule. https://tailwindcss.com/docs/functions-and-directives#apply-directive

atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v3 and earlier: inserts Tailwind's base/components/utilities styles. https://tailwindcss.com/docs/functions-and-directives#tailwind-directive

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: imports theme/utility definitions for use with @apply without duplicating output CSS, commonly used in Vue/Svelte <style> blocks. https://tailwindcss.com/docs/functions-and-directives#reference-directive
